confidence_notes: Restaurant and bar anchors rest mostly on undated or 2023-2024 comparison sites, with one July 2026 cappuccino data point. Hostel and guesthouse figures agree reasonably well across sources. 3-star hotel sources conflict widely (about $22 Skyscanner average vs about EUR 41 Trip.com), so 40 is a bounded midpoint judgement. Wine is priced off the local beer relationship because direct wine data was weak. FX is the most recent RBA observation I could obtain from a search snippet of the RBA page, dated 2026-03-20; it is likely stale relative to the 2026-10-16 generation date and I could not open the page to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors are Phnom Penh-specific, drawn from aggregated cost-of-living and accommodation sources, with wine estimated from the local beer relationship.
